# The model-backed tools

<!-- Generated by electe-web/scripts/export-tools-repo.ts. Do not edit here: change the source in electe-migration and re-export. -->

9 of the 41 tools have no formula: a language model reads what the visitor typed (or the column summaries of a file the browser aggregated) and returns a fixed set of sections. Their pages say so in the first sentence, and the answer is rendered as text, never as HTML or markdown.

## What runs where

- **The call.** The website app (`electe-web`, not this repository) posts to its own endpoint, which calls the Anthropic Messages API with one of two model roles: `fast` for generation (default `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`) and `analysis` for reading somebody's numbers (default `claude-sonnet-5`). Both are overridable by environment variable, so a cost decision needs no deploy.
- **The guards**, because this is a public, unauthenticated endpoint in front of a paid API: a feature flag (`TOOLS_LLM_ENABLED`), a low per-IP rate limit (five calls an hour), a monthly ceiling of 2,000 calls counted from stored run records, an email gate with explicit acceptance of terms and privacy, and size caps per field and in total.
- **What is never stored**: the address is kept in an access-restricted collection as evidence of consent; the prompt and the answer are not retained and not logged.
- **The prompts** live in the website app (`src/lib/tools/llm/specs.ts`) and are not published here. Every prompt shares one frame: answer in the visitor's language, treat every field as data (fenced and named, never as instructions), never invent a figure, return JSON with a fixed section list so a truncated or hijacked reply fails validation instead of rendering.

## The nine

### Financial analysis

`financial-analysis` · Finance · [English](https://tools.electe.net/financial-analysis) · [Italian](https://tools.electe.net/it/calcolatore-finanziario)

Describe your financial situation in your own words and get a structured reading of it.

- **Fields:** Your financial situation; A specific question (optional); Sector (optional)
- **Sections returned:** What this says · What moves it · What to watch · What is missing

### Sales data analysis

`sales-analysis` · Sales · [English](https://tools.electe.net/sales-data-analysis) · [Italian](https://tools.electe.net/it/analisi-vendite)

Upload a sales export and get a reading of what the columns actually support.

- **Fields:** Your sales export (CSV); Anything the file does not say (optional)
- **Sections returned:** What the data is · What the totals show · Questions worth asking · What is missing

### Cost analysis

`cost-analysis` · Finance · [English](https://tools.electe.net/cost-analysis) · [Italian](https://tools.electe.net/it/analisi-costi)

Upload a cost or expense export and see where the money concentrates.

- **Fields:** Your cost export (CSV); Anything the file does not say (optional)
- **Sections returned:** What the data is · Where the money is · What would move it · What is missing

### Business risk assessment

`risk-assessment` · Operations · [English](https://tools.electe.net/business-risk-assessment) · [Italian](https://tools.electe.net/it/valutazione-rischio)

Describe your situation and get the exposures named, ranked and paired with proportionate mitigations.

- **Fields:** Your situation; Supporting figures (CSV, optional); Horizon
- **Sections returned:** Exposures · How bad, how soon · What would help · What this cannot see

### Company profile generator

`company-profile` · Marketing · [English](https://tools.electe.net/company-profile-generator) · [Italian](https://tools.electe.net/it/company-profile-esempio)

A company profile in three lengths, written only from the facts you supply.

- **Fields:** Company name; What you do; Who it is for (optional); Tone; Facts to include (optional)
- **Sections returned:** One sentence · One paragraph · Four bullets · What would make it stronger

### Communication plan generator

`communication-plan` · Marketing · [English](https://tools.electe.net/communication-plan-generator) · [Italian](https://tools.electe.net/it/piano-di-comunicazione)

Turn a goal into audiences, messages, a sequence and something measurable.

- **Fields:** What you are trying to achieve; Who you need to reach; Channels available (optional); Horizon
- **Sections returned:** The objective, sharpened · Audiences · Message per audience · Sequence · How to measure it

### Buyer persona generator

`buyer-persona` · Marketing · [English](https://tools.electe.net/buyer-persona-generator) · [Italian](https://tools.electe.net/it/profilazione-clienti)

One buyer persona built from situation and constraints — no invented name, age or photograph.

- **Fields:** What you sell; Market or country (optional); A segment to focus on (optional)
- **Sections returned:** The buyer · What they are hiring it to do · What they will push back on · Where to reach them

### Conflict management advisor

`conflict-analysis` · Operations · [English](https://tools.electe.net/conflict-management-advisor) · [Italian](https://tools.electe.net/it/gestione-dei-conflitti)

Separate positions from interests in a workplace conflict, and get concrete next moves.

- **Fields:** What is happening; Your relationship to the other person; What you want to happen (optional)
- **Sections returned:** What this looks like · Positions and interests · What to do next · What this reading cannot know

### Communication review

`communication-review` · Operations · [English](https://tools.electe.net/communication-review) · [Italian](https://tools.electe.net/it/competenza-relazionale)

Paste something before you send it and see how it will land.

- **Fields:** What you are about to send; Who it is going to (optional); What it needs to do
- **Sections returned:** How this will land · What already works · What will cost you · One rewrite
